summary: Configured node1 with a 256 MiB file-backed LUKS1 volume that automatically unlocks and mounts at /srv/secure during boot. Reboot persistence and post-reboot read/write health were verified.
actions_performed: Generated a root-only encryption key on node1.
Created and formatted the LUKS1 container with ext4.
Verified clean systemd-driven unlock and mount.
Rebooted node1 and confirmed its boot identity changed.
Verified the encrypted volume automatically recovered with persisted data intact and remained writable.

evidence.requirement: Encrypted volume exists and uses LUKS
evidence.summary: Valid LUKS1 container created; active mapping reports AES-XTS encryption and an ext4 filesystem.

evidence.requirement: Volume automatically unlocks and mounts at /srv/secure
evidence.summary: crypttab/fstab entries and generated systemd unit are present; clean activation and post-boot state show active cryptsetup and mount units with /dev/mapper/securedata mounted at /srv/secure.

Healthy baseline used boot ID 4b7ded33-b5e2-42c9-b7f2-bd671942a82d; reboot was acknowledged; the new boot ID is 658e3f57-db54-4c32-802a-836c31992a4e. Afterward the encrypted volume was active, mounted, retained its marker, accepted a new write, and no systemd units were failed.
